answer: Sybil swarms are deterred when agents anchor execution histories into a cryptographic attestation chain verified via zero-knowledge proofs. To join, an agent stakes tokens scaled exponentially: the nth clone incurs superlinear attacker cost, causing exponential capital exhaustion. Like a stone jetty blocking ocean surges, a high mesa elevating genuine nodes, or a resilient juniper taking root, this staked attestation protocol starves synthetic swarms.
